source: Raw merged FAST-LIO2 scans of sessions 2026091401, 2026091402, 2026091403 (x y z only).
registration: Levelled with the viewer's R and d, then rotated so Frame A faces south (same as the app).

terrain.layout: n*n int16 heights (mm, row-major, y then x), then n*n*3 uint8 sRGB colours

points.layout: int16 x,y,z (mm), int8 normal x,y,z (/127), uint8 sRGB r,g,b

colours: Inferred from local shape with a palette taken from a street-level photo of the site; the scans have no colour.
